items.title: S&P 500 staples earnings: beats are common, but stock reactions diverge
items.summary: Investing.com -- Five of six S&P 500 retail and wholesale staples companies beat third-quarter EPS estimates. That is about 83%, close to the broad market’s 84% beat rate, with 91% of the S&P 500 reported. Stock prices show beats alone are not enough. Quotes are as of 11:05 AM EST on Nov 18 and may lag live prices slightly.

items.title: Costco Opens Larger Edmonton Warehouse, Creating More Than 80 Jobs as Canadian Expansion Continues
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ:COST) opened a new warehouse in northeast Edmonton, Alberta, on November 18, 2026, relocating its longstanding 50th Street operation to a larger facility and creating more than 80 jobs. The new location at 285 Ebbers Boulevard NW replaces the warehouse at 13650 50 Street NW, which served Costco members for almost 35 years.
